scope: Three clear, unisex full-size lip balms for men's everyday lip-care reference. Separate from the twenty lipstick container designs; no tinted shade duplicates.

entries.descriptionZh: 白色与金色拼接金属管身，打开后露出黑色内管和浅色膏体。官网将妆效描述为半哑光、接近隐形，并明确说明适合女性或男性使用；这是一款无色日常护理产品。
entries.introEn: An untinted balm in a white-and-gold metal tube. Hermès describes its finish as semi-matte and almost invisible, suitable for women or men.
entries.availabilityZh: 复核时官网提供加入购物袋入口；购买前再确认库存。
entries.method: Official US page snapshot reviewed 2026-11-13, reader crawl label today: reference V60854BV000, Transparent / Blanc, USD86. Body explicitly says semi-matte, almost invisible, suitable for women or men. Full tube, not refill.
entries.imageAlt: Hermès Rouge Hermès Lip Care Balm V60854BV000 — white and gold cap beside open untinted balm
entries.imageRights: Product photograph used for editorial identification, credited to the source. Rights remain with the rights holder; no open reuse license was identified.

entries.descriptionZh: 银色方管配有 Prada 标志与几何环带，图中打开的浅绿色膏体对应 U000 Universal。官网将这一具体版本标为无色、柔雾妆效；浅绿色膏体不代表涂后呈绿色。
entries.introEn: U000 Universal is the clear, soft-matte version of Prada Balm. Its silver square case and geometric ring give the everyday object a distinct silhouette.
entries.availabilityZh: 复核时美国官网的 U000 正装显示缺货／到货通知；所列为官网正装参考价。
entries.method: Exact official US SKU 3614273855761 snapshot reviewed 2026-11-13, crawled today: U000 UNIVERSAL selected, Standard selected, USD50; current SKU out of stock. Shade description says clear, soft matte. Refill USD40 excluded.
entries.imageAlt: Prada Balm U000 Universal 3614273855761 — open clear balm and silver square cap
entries.imageRights: Product photograph used for editorial identification, credited to the source. Rights remain with the rights holder; no open reuse license was identified.

entries.descriptionZh: 绿松石色管盖与带细纹的金色管身形成鲜明对比。1 Joslyn Clair 是官网明确标注的透明款，偏柔和自然光泽；想保留唇色、又接受一点亮度时可以从这一款了解。
entries.introEn: The transparent Joslyn Clair balm pairs a turquoise cap with a textured gold-toned tube. It offers a soft sheen while leaving the natural lip color visible.
entries.availabilityZh: 此卡只收录透明的 1 Joslyn Clair；同系列有色版本合并了解，不另开图卡。
entries.method: Official Gucci US exact reference 5861709PLP99001 snapshot reviewed 2026-11-13, crawled today: USD50 and Transparent lip balm. Official lip collection describes soft glow. Photograph identifies exact 1 Joslyn Clair via Bloomingdale's product page; merchant USD49 is not used as official quote.
entries.imageAlt: Gucci Baume à Lèvres 1 Joslyn Clair — turquoise cap and open transparent balm in gold tube
